test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

Life's many events __give shape to__ a person's individuality.
solution: The correct answer is** 'No substitution required'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically correct. • Here, **'give shape to' **is a phrase. • It means** 'To explain or detail something**'. • *Example: Once you** give shape to **your vision for the ad campaign, I think the boss will support it.* • The underlined part is correct. • Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**. **Correct Answer:__** *Life's many events **give shape to** a person's individuality.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही है। • यहाँ** 'give shape to'** एक मुहावरा है। • इसका अर्थ है 'किसी बात की व्याख्या या विस्तार करना'। • *Example: Once you** give shape to** your vision for the ad campaign, I think the boss will support it.* • रेखांकित भाग सही है। • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4 **है। 30:T627, The correct answer is '**who**'.
